column2: This garden may have originally been a place connected to the woman's ghost. ||| Hehe, thinking that way, it does feel like something is protecting us.
...... ||| ...Understood. Take me there.
...... ||| ...I'm ready. Take me there.
(The Sword Emperor, Leonhardt...) ||| (...He seemed to know about my sister...)
I don't know the details very well either, but... one thing I can say is that I think Joshua has overcome a big wall.
Well, I don't know the details, but... I can say this much. ||| ...Joshua's got a really good look on his face now.
Anelace... ||| ...Thank you.
And Estelle too!
Ah, haha... You think so?
The Arseille is that beautiful white ship, right? ||| Hehe, Renne has wanted to ride it for a long time. ||| The view from the deck must be wonderful, don't you think?
Oh, big sis... ||| No sneaking bites, okay?
W-what I just did wasn't sneaking a bite. ||| ...It was only a taste test.
Renne wants to ride the Arseille soon. ||| Hehe, once we're ready, let's go out.
It feels like a picnic...
Oh, Renne. What are you doing here...? ||| Ah, are you guessing the next Guardian? ||| *sigh* It'd help a lot if we knew their techniques in advance...
Hehe, you're right. ||| The Shadow Lord's choice of people is really interesting... ||| I wonder who will show up next in the fairy-tale land. ||| I can't wait!
Can't wait...? ||| Aren't you going to guess for us?
Oh, that would be boring. ||| Fairy tales are fun because they're exciting.
...There's something that's been bothering me. ||| Isn't that a little inappropriate?
Inappropriate...?

Judging by what he's done so far, the Shadow Lord is clearly our enemy. ||| There are people being used by the Shadow Lord, even if only their personalities. ||| Talking about this situation as if it were a child's make-believe is rather beside the point, don't you think?
R-Ries...
...... ||| Big sis, why are you angry?
...I'm not angry. ||| But it should be our shared understanding that the Lord is our enemy. ||| I cannot allow remarks that endorse such a being.
Hmm... ||| Come to think of it, the Shadow Lord seems quite provocative... ||| Hehe, does that have something to do with your irritation, big sis?
...You know, the Shadow Lord seems interested in the Heretic Hunter. ||| But even I don't know the circumstances... ||| Hehe... Is that why you got angry?
...... ||| Please don't forget. This is not a game. ||| However much of a genius you are, believing you can have everything your way is arrogance.
...All right, all right, stop it.
You two... that's enough, okay?
Renne, Ries and the others have their own circumstances, so don't say things like that.
And you too, Ries. ||| You keep saying "genius," but Renne is, after all, just an ordinary girl.
...... ||| I don't quite understand what you mean...

Listen, Ries. ||| Sure, Renne is smart and has incredible power... ||| but that doesn't change that she's an ordinary girl. ||| She's selfish and moody, precocious and cheeky, and finds everything amusing... ||| But she's surprisingly caring and can be considerate of others. ||| Don't you think she's just an ordinary girl who could go to Sunday school?
...Estelle......

So please don't write Renne off as special from the start. ||| Accept her as an ordinary kid, and if you still have complaints, feel free to say them... ||| but the way you're talking, I feel you're taking it too one-sidedly...
...... ||| You're right... ||| Perhaps I was looking at it a bit one-sidedly.
...I'm sorry, Renne.
Oh... Big sis is quite honest. ||| ...Though it seems you still have a lot you want to say to me.
Of course. ||| It's an elder's role to guide a child who doesn't know right from wrong.
Oh, I agree with that. ||| As long as we're here, we're Renne's guardians.
H-hmph... Say whatever you like.
...By the way, Estelle. ||| You just called Renne an ordinary kid who goes to Sunday school, right?
Huh? Yeah... what about it?

Think of Renne however you like, that's your business... ||| but let me correct one thing. ||| ...If anything, Renne is the one who teaches, not the one taught. ||| After all, I hold three doctorates.
Chemistry, mathematics and information theory... I publish papers regularly too. ||| I hide my identity and use a proxy because I dislike the fuss.
Ha, haha... So that's how it is...
(This is... going to be a lot of trouble to discipline.)
*sigh*... Don't underestimate Renne. ||| Besides, if Renne doesn't lend a hand, you'll never escape this world, will you?
Ah, all right, I get it. ||| I'm counting on you, Renne.
To think they recreated that squinty-eyed old man. ||| Hehe, the Shadow Lord has quite a sense for games. ||| ...I want to try fighting soon. ||| Maybe I'll sneak ahead.
R-Renne, honestly... ||| It's dangerous outside, so don't go out alone, okay?
Staying behind is boring. ||| Maybe I'll sneak ahead...
Renne has lots of stuffed animals too. ||| Renne's room is already full of them. ||| Hehe, I'd like to show them to Tita and big sis.
Hehe, Renne's room is already full of stuffed animals. ||| I'd like to show them to Tita and big sis.
Oh, Renne!
Oh, Tita, are you going out with Estelle? ||| Renne is bored alone.
S-sorry, Renne... ||| Um, then let's go shopping together next time. ||| Hehe, I bought a pretty brooch at the department store the other day...
Hehe, that did happen. ||| Come to think of it, Renne found a matching brooch at a little shop the other day. ||| The gem in the middle is red.
Wow, lucky... ||| The department store in the capital had sold out... ||| *sigh* I wanted a red one too...
Then Tita, why don't we visit a faraway shop together sometime? ||| The Eastern quarter in the Republic never gets boring, even all day.
Is that so... ||| Hehe, then I'd like to look at cute accessories again! ||| You see, about the pendant I bought the other day...
(...Hmm, they're really getting into it.)
...At that shop I found a brooch that matches the one I bought. ||| The gem in the middle is red.
Hehe, Renne found such a big teddy bear at a shop in the Empire the other day. ||| It's as big as a grown man.
W-wow... ||| I'd like to see it too...
Right, the Empire had lots of big shops too. ||| Hehe, I found such a big teddy bear the other day. ||| It's as big as a grown man.
...Pyui!
Zin is pecking at food from Kloe's hand.
